sana: Quick design ask iterating on the Credentials list. Main goals: make revoke safer (soft-grace), show an impact score, and tidy a11y/focus behavior. Figma: https://figma.com/snap/cred-grace. Looking for quick takes on copy + keyboard flow. fergus: Nice direction. Two requests: 1) surface an "impact score" (0-100) so users get a sense of blast radius, 2) distinguish tone between rotate vs revoke visually and copy-wise. sam: Accessibility notes: when revoke is scheduled, announce via aria-live and focus the Undo control. If the row drops after the grace window, announce removal and move focus to the next logical element (next row or the create CTA). Also ensure dialog tab order is logical: description -> secondary -> primary (cancel before destructive in DOM). anika: Copy + behavior proposal: - Grace window: 180s (3 minutes) undo period for revoke. - Revoke modal body: "This will invalidate the key. Requests using it will fail. You can undo for 3 minutes." - Rotate modal body: "Creates a replacement key. Old key stays active for 2 minutes to allow cutover." - Bulk typed confirm threshold: >3 items require typing the word "REVOKE". sana: Impact score idea: compute a heuristic based on recent route hits + last-used recency. Show: "Impact score: 72/100 (likely to affect production routes)" with a tooltip explaining it"Estimated from last 90 days of route usage". If we can't compute, show "Impact unknown". fergus: UX nit: permission chips feel heavy. Proposed compact pill: "Perms: billing,logs (+2)" that expands on hover/focus. On keyboard focus it should open a small popover with full list. Keeps rows tidy. sam: aria example for the queued revoke toast (screenreader-first):
Revocation scheduled for "payments-key".
Programmatically move focus to the Undo button when the toast appears if the action was keyboard-triggered. anika: For bulk selections with mixed states, show grouped counts: "3 will be revoked • 1 already revoked • 2 scheduled". Only items that will change require typing confirm. fergus: Visual emphasis: use an amber banner for rotate suggestions and solid red for revoke/destructive. Also add a small helper under the revoke CTA: "Tip: rotate to avoid downtime unless you need to cut access immediately." sam: Keyboard shortcut idea: when focus is inside the list, show a tooltip hint: "Shortcuts: R=Rotate • V=Revoke (when items selected)". Make sure shortcuts are scoped and opt-outtable. Also avoid letter conflicts with browser shortcuts. sana: Edge cases: rotating a key used by long-running jobs might need longer overlap. Suggest workspace-level override for overlap time. Also: if revoke is scheduled and the user attempts to rotate the same key, surface a conflict warning. anika: Copy variations Im favoring: Revoke header "Revoke API key" body "This will immediately invalidate the key. Requests using it will fail. You can undo for 3 minutes." Primary CTA "Revoke key" (destructive) Secondary "Cancel". Rotate header "Rotate key" body "Creates a replacement key. Old key active for 2 minutes to allow cutover." Primary CTA "Rotate and copy" Secondary "Cancel". fergus: For bulk typed-confirm copy: "Type REVOKE to confirm revocation of 5 keys". For >25 items, show an approval-required state. sam: Test cases to add to PR checklist: - Toast announced (aria-live) and Undo focused - Dialog traps focus and Esc closes - Focus returns appropriately after removal - Typed-confirm triggers only above threshold - Keyboard shortcuts scoped to list and documented in settings sana: Action items: I'll update the Figma with: queued revoke toast, impact score chip, compact perms pill, and typed-confirm thresholds. Sam, can you add the a11y checklist to the PR template? Fergus, can you mock the impact tooltip copy? I'll post new frames in ~40m. Thanks! :sparkles: aria-bot: Design review requested by sana. Reviewers: fergus, sam. Deadline: 48h."
